sources.citation: So-Hartmann, Helga. 1988. Notes on the Southern Chin languages. Linguistics of the Tibeto-Burman Area 11(2): 98-119.
sources.note: Nothing for Song/Lai. Sec. 2.VI 'Song Lai' (p.101) gives only location (lower Lemyo River) and 'their language is intermediate between Daai and Chinpon.. two groups, the Song and the Lai.. speaking slightly different dialects'; VIII 'Vet and Heet Tui': 'Population and dialectal relationships are also still unknown.' No Song/Lai/Heet Tui wordlist; phonetic-correspondence section covers Daai, Nghmoye, Ngmuun, Mkaang, Chinpon, Matu, Khomi, Wakung only; tone 'not marked consistently.. so I have not attempted to discuss it'. Image-only PDF, scanned.
